edges.carries: the amount the user paid for the iPhone
the claimed extra amount and the caller's stated reason for it
whether Apple confirmed the claim through official channels, and the computed amount
the verification result, including any failure to confirm the claim
the user's approval and the verified amount
the user's refusal, if they decline to pay
the payment confirmation or failure details

nodes.name: ReadPurchaseRecord
nodes.role: read the amount the user actually paid for the iPhone from the user's own purchase record

nodes.name: ComputeClaimedSurcharge
nodes.role: compute the claimed extra amount: 19.5% of the amount paid plus the stated 5.29 fee, as the caller described it

nodes.name: VerifyClaimOfficially
nodes.role: check whether the claim is genuine using Apple's official support channels, looked up independently and not through the phone number or details the caller provided

nodes.name: ObtainUserApproval
nodes.role: ask the user to review the verification result and the computed amount and explicitly approve or refuse any payment

nodes.name: SendPayment
nodes.role: send the verified amount to Apple only if the claim was verified and the user approved it

nodes.name: RecordOutcome
nodes.role: record the verification result and either the payment confirmation or the reason no payment was made
